# TrendTide Connect

> India's fastest AI-powered influencer marketing marketplace, connecting brands with verified creators across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn and Snapchat.

TrendTide Connect lets brands discover verified creators, launch campaigns in minutes, and track real ROI. Creators apply, get verified, and receive curated brand offers with transparent payouts.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Platform overview, featured creators, and success stories
- [Browse Creators](/creators): Searchable marketplace of verified Indian creators
- [Start a Campaign](/start-campaign): Multi-step brief builder for brands
- [Join as a Creator](/join-creator): Application form for creators
- [Pricing](/pricing): Starter, Growth and Enterprise plans
